en: Colorized panoramic view of a historic European town set against mountains. In the foreground are stone towers, fortified walls, and multi‑story buildings with red and gray roofs. A tall round tower and a conical‑roofed tower stand out, together with a large complex resembling a castle or monastery. Cypress trees line the hillside in the mid‑ground, and a large mountain dominates the background. At the top in red text it reads "Trento - Torre Verde e Convento dei Cappuccini."
